newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia Airlines begins scheduled Sarajevo flights.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Airlines begins scheduled Sarajevo flights.

text.p: Croatia Airlines d.d., the national flag carrier, said on Monday it was launching 12 scheduled flights to the Bosnian capital Sarajevo this month.
It said in a news release flights would depart Zagreb at 1325 local (1125 GMT) on September 2, 6, 9, 11, 23, 27 and 30, arriving at Sarajevo at 1445 (1245 GMT).
Departure on return was planned for 1535 (1335 GMT).
There would also be five evening flights at 1810 local (1710 GMT) on September 4, 5, 18, 25 and 26, with return scheduled at 2020 (1820).

The airline said all the flights running up to September 11 had been approved by the flight control of the international peace force (IFOR) and Bosnian authorities. It expected to obtain approval for the remaining flights next week.
